name: PVC Heat Shrink Tubes / Busbar Insulation
summary: Lay-flat PVC heat shrink sleeves that insulate low tension busbars in control panels and switchgear, from 17 mm to 300 mm wide.
intro: PVC heat shrinkable lay-flat tubing from Akcelport Industries gives clean insulation for busbars of low tension systems in control panels and switchgear. Busbar sleeves are a modern alternative to the age-old method of taping and painting.
They are available from 17 mm up to 300 mm in width, and in thickness from 80 microns to 400 microns, for the complete range of busbars. Please ask us for any customisation.
features: Colours: red, yellow, blue, black, green, brown, grey, white
Excellent mechanical strength and heat dissipation
